info.title: Ashes of the Sun-Dial prototype design

messages.text:
"Act as a Senior Game Designer and Lead Mobile Game Developer. Design the core architecture, gameplay loop, combat mechanics, and initial prototype code for a 2D Isometric Action RPG built specifically for iOS and Android mobile devices.

1. Art Direction @COMMENT_BODY@ Visual Style
- Visual Inspiration: Combine the vibrant, hand-painted gothic aesthetic and isometric camera angle of Hades with the gritty pixel-art textures, dynamic lighting, and fluid hit-stop animations of Dead Cells.
- Mobile Optimization: Use high-contrast character silhouettes and bright, clear visual telegraphs for enemy attacks so actions are readable on small screens. Keep UI elements minimal and anchored to the screen edges.

2. Original Story @COMMENT_BODY@ Setting: \"Ashes of the Sun-Dial\"
- Premise: You play as Kaelen, a disgraced \"Chrono-Warden\" exiled to the Sunken Spire, a shifting, cursed tower where time flows backward.
- The Conflict: The Spire is ruled by the Hollow Monarchs, ancient kings who stole fragments of the World-Clock to achieve immortality, freezing the outside world in eternal twilight.
- Objective: Ascend the Spire, defeat the Hollow Monarchs, and shatter their time-fragments to restore the natural flow of time. Each run uncovers lost memories of Kaelen's own role in the world's downfall.

3. Core Gameplay @COMMENT_BODY@ Mobile Controls
- Movement: Left-side floating virtual joystick with a quick-flick gesture to trigger a short invulnerability dash.
- Combat Actions (Right-side thumb buttons):
  * Primary Attack: Fast 3-hit melee combo.
  * Parry / Deflect: A dedicated button with a tight active window (0.25 seconds).
  * Signature Skill: A heavy elemental attack fueled by successful parries.
- The Parry Mechanic:
  * Tapping Parry right before an enemy strikes negates all damage, triggers a brief \"hit-stop\" slow-motion effect, refills 25% of the Skill Meter, and inflicts Stagger on the enemy.
  * Parrying a boss's heavy attack breaks their posture, opening them up for a high-damage critical riposte.
  * Missing a parry puts the button on a 1.2-second cooldown to punish button-mashing.

4. RPG Stat @COMMENT_BODY@ Progression System
Design a stat system where players allocate points upon leveling up or equipping salvaged relics:
- Might (STR): Increases base melee attack damage and critical riposte multipliers.
- Reflex (DEX): Increases attack speed and slightly widens the active parry window (up to a balanced cap).
- Resonance (INT): Boosts Signature Skill damage and increases Skill Meter gained per parry.
- Vitality (VIT): Increases maximum health and reduces chip damage taken if a parry is timed slightly early.

5. Your Deliverables
Provide the following to kick off development:
1. Tech Stack Recommendation: Suggest the best game engine (e.g., Unity or Godot) for an isometric mobile game with this art style and explain why.
2. Core Combat State Machine: Write clean, modular prototype code handling the player's Idle, Move, Attack, Dash, and Parry states, including the parry timing window and cooldown logic.
3. First Boss Concept: Design the first Hollow Monarch boss, detailing 3 distinct attack patterns that teach the player how to use the parry mechanic.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
